markets.name: Polypropylene futures
markets.about: Most-traded polypropylene contract in China. Sets the tone for PP prices across Asia.

markets.name: LLDPE futures
markets.about: Linear low-density polyethylene contract. The best free daily guide to polyethylene (PE) prices.

markets.name: PVC futures
markets.about: PVC resin contract. China is the world's largest PVC producer and a key supplier to India.

markets.name: MEG futures
markets.about: Mono-ethylene glycol contract, used for polyester and antifreeze.

markets.name: Styrene futures
markets.about: Styrene monomer contract, used for polystyrene, ABS and resins.

markets.name: Pure benzene futures
markets.about: Benzene contract (listed July 2025). Benzene feeds styrene, phenol/acetone, LAB and more.

markets.name: LPG futures
markets.about: Liquefied petroleum gas contract. A feedstock signal for propylene, IPA and MEK.

markets.name: PTA futures
markets.about: Purified terephthalic acid contract, the main raw material for polyester.

markets.name: Methanol futures
markets.about: Methanol contract. China makes most of its methanol from coal.

markets.name: Caustic soda futures
markets.about: Caustic soda contract (listed Sept 2023).

markets.name: Soda ash futures
markets.about: Soda ash (sodium carbonate) contract, driven by glass and detergent demand.

markets.name: Paraxylene futures
markets.about: Paraxylene contract (listed Sept 2023). PX feeds PTA and tracks the aromatics chain including xylene.

markets.name: Propylene futures
markets.about: Propylene contract (listed July 2025). Propylene feeds PP, acetone/phenol, IPA and propylene glycol.

markets.name: Urea futures
markets.about: Urea fertiliser contract.

markets.name: Aluminium futures
markets.about: Aluminium contract. A cost signal for aluminium-based water treatment chemicals such as PAC.

markets.name: Brent crude oil
markets.about: The global oil benchmark. Most petrochemicals follow crude with a lag. Published by FRED a few days late.

markets.name: WTI crude oil
markets.about: US crude oil benchmark.

markets.name: Natural gas (Henry Hub)
markets.about: US natural gas price, a cost signal for methanol, ammonia and urea.

markets.name: Propane (Mont Belvieu)
markets.about: Propane price. Propane is cracked into propylene, the start of the PP/acetone/IPA chain.

markets.name: US dollar to rupee
markets.about: A weaker rupee (higher number) makes every imported chemical dearer in rupees.

markets.name: Chinese yuan to rupee
markets.about: Used to convert China prices into rupees.

chemicals.name: Toluene
chemicals.about: Aromatic solvent for paints, thinners, adhesives and inks; also a feedstock for benzene and xylenes.

chemicals.name: Xylene (mixed)
chemicals.about: Solvent for paints, coatings, pesticides and rubber. India imports small, irregular volumes, so the import price can jump.

chemicals.name: Acetone
chemicals.about: Fast-drying solvent and raw material for bisphenol-A, MMA and pharma. Made with phenol from benzene and propylene.

chemicals.name: Isopropyl alcohol (IPA)
chemicals.hsNote: The customs group also includes n-propanol; IPA is most of it.
chemicals.about: Cleaning and disinfecting solvent used in pharma, electronics, inks and coatings.

chemicals.name: Methyl ethyl ketone (MEK)
chemicals.about: Solvent for PU and vinyl coatings, adhesives, printing inks and lube-oil dewaxing.

chemicals.name: Methanol
chemicals.about: Base chemical for formaldehyde, acetic acid and solvents. India imports most of its methanol.

chemicals.name: Ethyl acetate
chemicals.about: Solvent for flexible-packaging inks, adhesives and pharma. India is mainly an exporter, so import volumes are small.

chemicals.name: Polypropylene (PP)
chemicals.about: Most widely used plastic for woven sacks, packaging, moulded parts and fibres.

chemicals.name: Polyethylene (PE)
chemicals.hsNote: Imports add LLDPE/LDPE (below 0.94 density) and HDPE (0.94 and above).
chemicals.about: Film, pipes, blow-moulded containers and packaging. Daily signal is China's LLDPE contract.

chemicals.name: PVC resin
chemicals.about: Pipes, fittings, profiles, cables and flooring. India imports a large share of its PVC.

chemicals.name: Epoxy resin
chemicals.about: Coatings, adhesives, composites and electrical laminates. Made from bisphenol-A and epichlorohydrin.

chemicals.name: Benzene
chemicals.about: Core aromatic feedstock for styrene, phenol, LAB, cyclohexane and more.

chemicals.name: Propylene
chemicals.about: Feedstock for PP, acetone/phenol, IPA, acrylics and propylene glycol. India imports little; daily signal is China futures.

chemicals.name: Mono-ethylene glycol (MEG)
chemicals.news: monoethylene glycol|mono ethylene glycol|ethylene glycol|MEG price
chemicals.about: Polyester fibre and PET bottles, coolants and antifreeze.

chemicals.name: Purified terephthalic acid (PTA)
chemicals.about: Main raw material for polyester fibre, film and PET resin.

chemicals.name: Styrene monomer
chemicals.about: Polystyrene, ABS, SBR rubber and unsaturated polyester resins.

chemicals.name: Phenol
chemicals.about: Bisphenol-A, phenolic resins (laminates, plywood glue) and pharma. Made alongside acetone.

chemicals.name: Caustic soda
chemicals.hsNote: Import series is solid caustic (flakes). India is a net exporter, so import volumes are small.
chemicals.about: Alumina, textiles, soaps, paper, water treatment and countless chemical processes.

chemicals.name: Soda ash
chemicals.about: Glass, detergents, sodium silicate and chemicals.

chemicals.name: Linear alkyl benzene (LAB)
chemicals.about: Raw material for LABSA, the main active in detergent powders and liquids.

chemicals.name: Anionic surfactants (incl. SLES)
chemicals.hsNote: Broad customs group: other anionic surfactants, which includes SLES. Treat the price as a group average.
chemicals.about: Foaming and cleaning agents for shampoos, detergents and personal care.

chemicals.name: Poly aluminium chloride (PAC)
chemicals.hsNote: Customs group 'chlorides of aluminium'. India makes most PAC locally, so import volumes are small.
chemicals.about: Coagulant for drinking-water and effluent treatment, paper and textiles.

chemicals.name: Ferric chloride
chemicals.hsNote: India has no separate customs code for ferric chloride; it sits in 'other chlorides'. This import price is a broad group average, not a ferric chloride price.
chemicals.about: Coagulant for sewage, effluent and drinking-water treatment, and an etchant for circuit boards.

chemicals.name: Citric acid
chemicals.about: Acidulant for beverages and food, plus cleaners and pharma. India imports mostly from China.

chemicals.name: Choline chloride
chemicals.hsNote: Customs group 'choline and its salts'. India produces most of its own, so import volumes are tiny and the price is noisy.
chemicals.about: Feed additive for poultry and cattle; also used in oilfield chemicals.

chemicals.name: Glycerine
chemicals.about: Pharma, personal care, food and resins. Supply is tied to biodiesel and soap-making.

chemicals.name: Propylene glycol (MPG)
chemicals.about: Pharma and food grades for excipients and flavours; industrial grade for resins and coolants.

chemicals.name: Urea
chemicals.about: Main nitrogen fertiliser; also used in resins and DEF (AdBlue). India is a top importer.

chemicals.name: Herbicides (group)
chemicals.hsNote: Product group: all herbicides, anti-sprouting products and plant-growth regulators. Useful for demand trends, not for any single molecule's price.
chemicals.about: Imports of weed-control products, a guide to agrochemical demand and seasonality.

chemicals.name: Insecticides (group)
chemicals.hsNote: Product group: all insecticides. Useful for demand trends, not for any single molecule's price.
chemicals.about: Imports of insect-control products, a guide to agrochemical demand and seasonality.
